verdicts.explanation: The paper states the Nernst-Einstein σ of LPSCl-II as 1.53 × 10-3 ± 1.40 × 10-4 mS/cm, computed in this work. No temperature is given for σ, so null is correct.
The paper reports 2.37 ± 0.13 mS/cm for LSPSCl (Si-substituted argyrodite, P replaced by Si) as a computed value, with no temperature stated for σ.
The paper gives 8.42 ± 9.34× 10-2 mS/cm for LPSCl-III (Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5) from this work's simulations; the 9.4 mS/cm figure is a separate literature value that the record correctly does not use.
The paper states LPSCl-I has the lowest conductivity at 1.10 × 10-7 ± 3.82 × 10-8 mS/cm, computed in this work, with no temperature given for σ.
The paper reports Li4Cr2C4SO16 at 5.05 ± 0.23 mS/cm, obtained by fitting Nernst-Einstein to this work's simulations, with no temperature stated for that value.
